attributes.probed_form:
NO SOURCE CHANGE MADE OR NEEDED. The premise was tested by reading data, not by editing. Evidence chain, all reproducible:

(1) regnorm on fn_8005FDA8 reports two OURS-ONLY relocation rows citing anonymous MWCC pool labels:
    UNPAIRED-O @0x00f0  lfs f2,0(0)   R_PPC_EMB_SDA21  @4127
    UNPAIRED-O @0x00f8  lfd f5,0(0)   R_PPC_EMB_SDA21  @4126
   against target rows citing splitter-invented names:
    @0x00f4  lfs f2,0(0)   R_PPC_EMB_SDA21  lbl_80347010
    @0x0100  lfd f5,0(0)   R_PPC_EMB_SDA21  lbl_80347008
   This is the surface shape the brief describes, so the premise is not frivolous.

(2) THE VALUES ARE IDENTICAL. build/GUNE5D/asm/auto_11_80345D70_sdata2.s defines them literally:
    .obj lbl_80347008, global / .double 64 / .endobj
    .obj lbl_80347010, global / .float -0.5 / .endobj
   config/GUNE5D/symbols.txt confirms both as plain `.sdata2` objects (`type:object size:0x8 align:8 data:double` and `size:0x4 align:4 data:float`) with no source-level identity.

(3) THE SOURCE ALREADY SPELLS THOSE EXACT LITERALS, at src/game/world/gauntworld.c lines 6181-6183: `d1 = 64.0 * (k * (lo - m[13])); d2 = 64.0 * (k * (hi - m[13])); lbl_80344194 = -0.5f;`. Dataflow in the aligned view confirms the binding: our `lfd f5,@4126` feeds `fmul f4,f5,f4` (the 64.0 multiply) and our `lfs f2,@4127` feeds `stfs f2,lbl_80344194` (the -0.5f store).

(4) THE CONTRAST CASE IS PRESENT AND CORRECT IN THE SAME WINDOW: at +0x108 BOTH streams cite the real global `sCameraVisibilityRadius` by name. That is a genuine named global, it is spelled identically on both sides, and it is what a real wrong-symbol defect looks like when fixed - it was fixed by attempt.HV_fn8005fda8-shadowed-literal-fix-and-memory-barrier-park.20260901.v1. Its presence proves the screen distinguishes the two situations rather than flagging everything.
attributes.residual:
PREMISE REFUTED BY MEASUREMENT. The differing relocation symbols on fn_8005FDA8's two constant loads are NOT a wrong-relocation-symbol defect and there is NO source-side spelling fix to make. Both sides emit their own compiler-generated .sdata2 pool entry for the SAME two literals (double 64.0 and float -0.5); MWCC names its entries `@4126`/`@4127` and the DOL splitter, having no symbol names for extracted data, invented `lbl_80347008`/`lbl_80347010` for the target's. This is the benign NonMatching-TU pool-label artifact ALREADY DOCUMENTED IN THIS TU, verbatim, by the config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json pin on fn_8005FB48: 'our own-pool 2^52 literal @1280 corresponds to the target's named lbl_80346ED8 (the benign NonMatching-TU pool-label artifact)'. Spelling these as `extern` reads of the lbl_ symbols would be the ERROR, not the cure - see claim.winglobals-link-block's standing rule that literal-address forms in Matching TUs are correct and must never be symbolified.

DISTINCTION THAT MATTERS FOR THE NEXT AGENT: an anonymous-vs-named relocation pair is a DEFECT only when the target's symbol is a real named object that other code also references (CameraSupervisor's class, and fn_8005FDA8's own already-fixed sCameraVisibilityRadius site). It is a benign ARTIFACT when the target's symbol is a splitter-invented `lbl_` over a compiler pool constant whose value the source already spells. The discriminator is the DATA at the address plus whether the symbol has non-pool referents - never the name shape alone, and never the scores, which are blind to both cases.

WHAT THE EVIDENCE ACTUALLY SUPPORTS: the two accepted records on this function stand unmodified and correctly describe the real residual. attempt.HV_fn8005fda8-shadowed-literal-fix-and-memory-barrier-park.20260901.v1 is CONFIRMED: the live blocker is check_permutation_dependences refusing every one of the 64 relocation-consistent complete matchings on the single obstruction `(7, 'mem')`, because webfrank models all memory as one resource and the target requires our `stfs f2,lbl_80344194` store to cross the `lfs f0,sCameraVisibilityRadius` load. That is a GUARD capability gap, not a function property (AGENTS.md discipline 14), and the two accesses are provably distinct SDA globals under distinct EMB_SDA21 relocations, so a memory-disambiguation capability keyed on relocation symbol identity would discharge it. attempt.gw-fn8005fda8-store-placement-is-scheduler-not-source.20260901.v1 is CONFIRMED and independently closes the source-order axis by a directional argument. fn_8005FDA8 REMAINS CORRECTLY PARKED at real 16, 110/110, multiset IDENTICAL.

COORDINATION, per the lane brief's instruction to coordinate by recording rather than by editing webfrank.py: the ONE thing that would move this function is a webfrank memory-disambiguation capability that treats two EMB_SDA21 accesses bearing DISTINCT relocation symbols as non-aliasing for the permutation dependence audit. That request belongs to the webfrank.py owner (WF lane). It is not authored here and no rule was written.
